prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters, simple rounded people with big round eyes, small dot pupils and overbites, made as foam-latex satirical puppets: matte painted latex skin with blotchy colour washes, glassy eyes, real cloth suits and wigs, in a real miniature set photographed under hard studio lamps.
